body_md:
This approves Zenodo deposits for project P3, *Circular-economy kernel: loops, cascades and industrial symbiosis*. Under the publication policy (Z5), each P3 run that has a compiled paper and a non-trivial PROVEN claim then gets its own Zenodo record and DOI at the weekly publication. Without this approval, proven P3 runs are published on GitHub only.

- **Creator:** Hart, Justin D. (Viridis LLC, ORCID 0009-0008-3082-2482). AI assistance is disclosed in the description.
- **Scope and novelty note:** in `config/channels.json` (`zenodo.projects.P3.record_note`). It says these are elementary results about the stated models, not new theorems, and that no measured rate, cost or environmental outcome is certified.
- **Links:** `isSupplementTo` the Reciprocity Corridor (10.5281/zenodo.21971047) and the Useful and Dissipated Work Ledger (10.5281/zenodo.22736716).
- **Existing records:** this does not touch any of them.

Zenodo DOIs cannot be deleted.
title: Approve Zenodo records for project P3
